notes: Adults must be 19 or older for the regular program, so this is a separate youth track. Ask about the age rule.
name: Youth Volunteer Program
what_you_do: High school students volunteer at the museum for a session and gain skills in a history setting. Perks include store discounts.
who_can_apply: High school age students. Exact ages not stated on the page.
duration: Three sessions a year: spring, summer and fall
deadline_text: Online applications are due by 11:59 p.m. on Nov 15, 2026. You hear back by Dec 13, 2026. The page does not say which session this is for.
how_to_apply: Fill out the form on the volunteer page. A phone interview is set up by email. Under 18 needs a parent's consent. Questions: volunteer@theworldwar.org or 816-888-8115.
